en: Sepia-toned postcard showing the entrance of a police school complex. Two symmetrical multi-storey buildings with steep tiled roofs flank a central gated archway. The arch bears an inscription identifying it as a state police school, with a small coat of arms above. In the foreground is a metal fence and gate; a few uniformed figures stand near the entrance. In the background are additional buildings and landscaped grounds. Printed script text at the top names the police school and its location in Meißen.
